answer: Agents bond stake before an epoch and evaluate its committed polynomial to derive rate-limit shares. Semaphore proofs bind each message to a tree member while keeping identity private. If the same agent sends duplicate messages under one nullifier, the resulting distinct Shamir shares can reconstruct its secret key, providing cryptographic evidence for immediate collateral slashing. The raven, horizon, and sparrow labels may serve as illustrative epoch domains, not separate identities.
